subject.title: [Bug]: Tool display missing file path when model uses "file" parameter alias

question: Should OpenClaw continue to display and diagnose `file`, `filePath`, and `file_path` aliases for Read/Write/Edit tool calls even though current execution validation now requires canonical `path`?
rationale: The reported display gap is real in current source, but current tests intentionally reject legacy alias-only execution inputs, so automation cannot choose whether aliases remain a supported compatibility/display contract.

options.title: Preserve alias display compatibility
options.body: Refresh the open PR so the active resolver, read-start guard, OpenClawKit metadata, and focused tests consistently handle `file`, `filePath`, `file_path`, and `path` in display/diagnostic surfaces.

options.title: Canonicalize on `path` only
options.body: Keep execution and display policy canonical, update diagnostics/tests/docs to make alias-only inputs intentionally unsupported, and close the linked PR direction.

options.title: Defer behind the linked PR
options.body: Leave this issue open until the linked PR is rebased and provides real behavior proof, then make the alias decision during PR review.

recommendation.title: Preserve alias display compatibility
recommendation.body: Refresh the open PR so the active resolver, read-start guard, OpenClawKit metadata, and focused tests consistently handle `file`, `filePath`, `file_path`, and `path` in display/diagnostic surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is tied to both the display resolver commit path and the embedded subscribe handler split, making him the strongest available routing owner for the alias-contract decision.
